note: Fixed before any model run (#1817 review M1). Reps outermost (1..conditions.json runs); within a rep the 22 cases in caseOrder (negative, design and scenario cases interleaved: never adjacent to their own kind and never last); within a case B then S. A cap stop therefore leaves the two conditions at most one trial apart and every case measured in the earlier reps. run-all.mjs runs only this order; run-trial.mjs refuses a planned trial that is not the next unreserved one and a replacement before every planned trial is reserved.
